column3: Retired Senior Police Officers’ Association
(Incorporation) Act, No. 3 of 2009
to afford Members an opportunity to meet together;
to promote the welfare of its members, their  families
and  that  of  other  retired  Police  Officers  and  their
families, who are non-members of the Association;
to assist the spouse of members, in organising the
“Ladies Wing” of the R. S. P. O. A.;
to  grant  financial  and  other  assistance  where
possible, to its members and any other retired Police
Officers;
to render to the country any service consistent with
the object of the Association;
to  help  and  assist  the  members  when  they  are  in
need of medical assistance;
to  collaborate  with  any  other  institution  or
organization,  whether  foreign  or  local  having
objects similar to those of the Corporation; and
to do any act or thing generally essential to achieve
the above objectives.
